\begin{abstract}
We describe how a rate varies across 30 regions of a synthetic grid in 2023. Moran's $I$ is 0.5908 under queen contiguity and 0.5832 with the 4 nearest neighbours as weights (permutation $p = 0.001$), so neighbouring regions are alike; local indicators find 7 high-high and 4 low-low regions. The study is descriptive and makes no causal claim.
\end{abstract}
